meta.title: Contact | NEXUS Research Group
meta.description: Contact the NEXUS Research Group — Hamerschlag Hall, Carnegie Mellon University, Pittsburgh, PA.

header.title: Get in touch
header.lead: For research collaborations, press enquiries, or questions about joining the group. Prospective students should use the interest form on the Join page.

mailing.title: Mailing address
lines: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering

items.label: Building
items.text: Hamerschlag Hall sits on the Cut side of campus, next to Roberts Engineering Hall. Room 2124 is on the second floor.

items.label: Parking
items.text: Visitor parking is available in the East Campus Garage on Forbes Avenue.

items.label: Transit
items.text: Port Authority bus routes 61A/61B/61C/61D and 71A/71B/71C/71D stop on Forbes Avenue at Morewood.

items.detail: Use the research interest form on the Join page rather than emailing directly.
Email Dr. Srimani with a short description of the proposed work.
Contact the CMU College of Engineering communications team, copying Dr. Srimani.
Email with dates, audience, and format. We generally respond within two weeks.

quickForm.title: Send a message
quickForm.lead: General enquiries only. Prospective students should use the Join page form.
quickForm.successMessage: Thanks — your message has been sent. We will reply as soon as we can.
quickForm.errorMessage: Something went wrong. Please email tsrimani@andrew.cmu.edu directly.
